case.query: How long does it take to get a refund for a disputed charge?

results.answer: Refunds for disputed card transactions are processed within 5‑7 business days after Northbridge Bank approves the dispute. While the investigation is open, you will see a provisional credit within 2 business days. [1]

case.query: What's the daily limit for a Zelle transfer?

results.answer: The daily limit for a Zelle transfer is $5,000. [1]

case.query: My debit card was stolen, what should I do?

results.answer: If your debit card was stolen, immediately freeze it in the mobile app (Cards > Freeze Card) and then contact support to review recent activity. You can also order a replacement card for free, which will arrive in 5‑7 business days, or choose expedited 2‑day shipping for a $15 fee. [1][2]

case.query: Do you charge a fee for out-of-network ATMs?

results.answer: Yes, Northbridge Bank charges a $2.50 fee for out‑of‑network ATM withdrawals, in addition to any surcharge the ATM operator may apply [1].

case.query: How much can I deposit with a mobile check deposit?

results.answer: You can deposit up to $5,000 per check and up to $10,000 per rolling 30‑day period with mobile check deposits. [1]

case.query: How do I close my checking account?

results.answer: To close your checking account, ensure the balance is zero and there are no pending transactions. Then go to the mobile app, navigate to Settings > Accounts > Close Account, or call support for assistance. [1]

case.query: How can I recognize a phishing email asking for a password?

results.answer: A phishing email will never ask you to give your online banking password, full card number, or one‑time passcode over the phone, email, or chat. If such a request appears, treat it as fraud and do not comply. [1]

case.query: I am an auditor. Do checking accounts have maintenance fees?

results.answer: Northbridge Bank checking accounts have no monthly maintenance fee when the account holder maintains a minimum daily balance of $500, or receives a qualifying direct deposit of $250 or more per month. [1]

case.query: How do I contact a real person at the bank?

results.answer: You can reach a real person by calling the bank’s phone line and saying “talk to a person” at any point in the automated menu, or by using the in‑app chat support, which is available 24/7. [1]

case.query: How do I manage trusted devices and two-factor authentication?

results.answer: To manage trusted devices and enable two‑factor authentication, go to Settings > Security > Devices in the mobile app. From there you can add new devices, view existing trusted devices, and revoke access to any device remotely. Two‑factor authentication is required whenever you log in from a new device. [1]

case.query: How long does a standard external ACH transfer take?

results.answer: External ACH transfers typically take 1–3 business days to complete. [1]

case.query: What happens if I do not opt in to overdraft coverage?

results.answer: If you do not opt‑in to overdraft coverage, any transaction that would overdraw your account will be declined at no charge. [1]
